plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, John Todd is credited on 1981 distinct recordings across 3 programs from 1937-12-17 through 1956-03-28. Documented roles include performer on 1981 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Lone Ranger (performer on 1979 recordings; 1979 distinct recordings), Challenge of the Yukon (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and The Green Hornet (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Tonto (1978 portrayals).
